location: Please contact Toyota Manila Bay to confirm the branch address.

VALUE.english: Toyota Manila Bay's approved service approach uses Toyota Genuine Parts and trained technicians, with the work and estimate explained before approval.
VALUE.taglish: Sa Toyota Manila Bay, Toyota Genuine Parts at trained technicians ang service approach. Ipinaliliwanag muna ang trabaho at estimate bago ninyo aprubahan.
VALUE.smsEnglish: Genuine parts, trained technicians and an upfront scope help compare service value.
VALUE.smsTaglish: Genuine parts, trained technicians at malinaw na scope ang service approach namin.

PRICE_OBJECTION.english: I understand the price concern po. Compare the parts and work included: our approved approach uses Toyota Genuine Parts and trained technicians. You can request an essential-only estimate and approve the work before it starts.
PRICE_OBJECTION.taglish: Naiintindihan ko po ang concern sa presyo. Ikumpara ang parts at trabahong kasama: Toyota Genuine Parts at trained technicians ang approach namin. Pwede kayong humingi ng essential-only estimate bago aprubahan ang trabaho.
PRICE_OBJECTION.smsEnglish: Genuine parts & trained technicians; ask for an upfront essential-only quote.
PRICE_OBJECTION.smsTaglish: Genuine parts at trained technicians; pwede ang upfront essential-only quote.

ESSENTIAL_QUOTE.english: An essential-only estimate should identify the required work and separate optional add-ons for your approval. A service advisor must confirm the vehicle-specific scope and quote; no essential-only price is configured here.
ESSENTIAL_QUOTE.taglish: Sa essential-only estimate, nakahiwalay ang kailangang trabaho at optional add-ons para sa approval ninyo. Service advisor ang magkukumpirma ng vehicle-specific scope at quote; walang naka-configure na essential-only price dito.
ESSENTIAL_QUOTE.smsEnglish: An advisor confirms required work, optional add-ons and quote before your approval.
ESSENTIAL_QUOTE.smsTaglish: Advisor ang magkukumpirma ng required work, optional add-ons at quote bago approval.

WAIT_TIME.english: A service advisor can check whether your vehicle and required work qualify for Express Maintenance. Turnaround and availability need confirmation; I cannot guarantee a waiting time.
WAIT_TIME.taglish: Maaaring tingnan ng service advisor kung qualified ang sasakyan at trabaho para sa Express Maintenance. Kailangan munang kumpirmahin ang availability at turnaround; walang guaranteed waiting time.
WAIT_TIME.smsEnglish: Ask an advisor about Express Maintenance eligibility and confirmed turnaround.
WAIT_TIME.smsTaglish: Ipa-check sa advisor ang Express Maintenance eligibility at confirmed turnaround.

PMS_DETAILS.english: The approved minor PMS scope includes Toyota Genuine Motor Oil, an oil filter, a sump washer, and a safety check. Additional major PMS work depends on the vehicle model and maintenance milestone; an advisor confirms the required items and quote.
PMS_DETAILS.taglish: Kasama sa approved minor PMS ang Toyota Genuine Motor Oil, oil filter, sump washer, at safety check. Depende sa model at maintenance milestone ang dagdag sa major PMS; advisor ang magkukumpirma ng items at quote.
PMS_DETAILS.smsEnglish: Minor PMS: Toyota Genuine oil, filter, sump washer & safety check. Major scope varies.
PMS_DETAILS.smsTaglish: Minor PMS: Toyota Genuine oil, filter, sump washer at safety check. Iba ang major scope.

INSURANCE_DETAILS.english: Toyota Insure options can cover repair through the dealer, genuine parts, and direct claims support according to the issued policy. Coverage, deductible, Acts of Nature, eligibility, and premium must be checked against your policy and confirmed quote.
INSURANCE_DETAILS.taglish: Maaaring kasama sa Toyota Insure ang dealer repair, genuine parts, at direct claims support ayon sa policy. Kailangang i-check sa policy at confirmed quote ang coverage, deductible, Acts of Nature, eligibility, at premium.
INSURANCE_DETAILS.smsEnglish: Dealer repair, genuine parts & claims support depend on policy; advisor confirms cover.
INSURANCE_DETAILS.smsTaglish: Depende sa policy ang dealer repair, genuine parts at claims; ipa-confirm ang coverage.

INSURANCE_OBJECTION.english: A cheaper broker quote may have different coverage po. Compare dealer repair, genuine parts, claims support, deductible, and Acts of Nature under each policy. A representative can confirm the Toyota Insure terms and premium; I cannot promise the lowest price.
INSURANCE_OBJECTION.taglish: Maaaring magkaiba ang coverage ng mas murang broker quote po. Ikumpara ang dealer repair, genuine parts, claims support, deductible, at Acts of Nature sa bawat policy. Representative ang magkukumpirma ng Toyota Insure terms at premium.
INSURANCE_OBJECTION.smsEnglish: Compare policy cover, dealer repair, parts, claims and deductible; confirm the quote.
INSURANCE_OBJECTION.smsTaglish: Ikumpara ang policy cover, dealer repair, parts, claims at deductible; ipa-confirm ang quote.

LTO_DETAILS.english: Registration concierge assistance supports inspection, CTPL checks where required, and document liaison. Required documents, eligibility, fees, and processing schedule need dealership confirmation.
LTO_DETAILS.taglish: Tumutulong ang registration concierge sa inspection, CTPL checks kung kailangan, at document liaison. Kailangan munang kumpirmahin sa dealership ang documents, eligibility, fees, at processing schedule.
LTO_DETAILS.smsEnglish: Concierge helps inspection, required CTPL and documents; advisor confirms fees and needs.
LTO_DETAILS.smsTaglish: Concierge: inspection, required CTPL at documents; advisor ang magko-confirm ng fees.

LTO_DIY.english: You can handle registration through LTMS yourself po. Our concierge option helps coordinate inspection, required CTPL checks, and document liaison if you prefer assistance. The applicable requirements and fees still need confirmation.
LTO_DIY.taglish: Pwede po kayong mag-asikaso sa LTMS mismo. Kung gusto ninyo ng tulong, maaaring i-coordinate ng concierge ang inspection, required CTPL checks, at document liaison. Kailangan pa ring kumpirmahin ang requirements at fees.
LTO_DIY.smsEnglish: DIY LTMS is an option; concierge helps inspection, required CTPL and document liaison.
LTO_DIY.smsTaglish: Pwede ang DIY LTMS; concierge helps inspection, required CTPL at documents.

BUNDLE.english: A combined visit can coordinate PMS, insurance assistance, and LTO registration assistance, subject to service availability, scheduling, and document checks. The advisor confirms which items apply to your vehicle and the final quote.
BUNDLE.taglish: Maaaring i-coordinate sa isang visit ang PMS, insurance assistance, at LTO registration assistance, depende sa service availability, schedule, at document checks. Advisor ang magkukumpirma ng applicable items at final quote.
BUNDLE.smsEnglish: One visit can coordinate PMS, insurance & LTO; schedules, documents and quote need checks.
BUNDLE.smsTaglish: PMS, insurance at LTO sa isang visit: ipa-check ang schedule, documents at quote.
